citation.description: Dockerfile exists at tests/external/live_jira_dc/Dockerfile with FROM addono/jira-software-standalone@sha256:... (no pull of pycontribs/jira-test-image). Operator-attested live run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30515632763 on commit bb951f6e4, ubuntu-latest (native x86_64), 'Build and start the Jira DC harness: SUCCESS', 'Wait for Jira DC to become ready: SUCCESS (Jira DC ready after 96 tries)', '4 passed in 6.39s'.

criteria.criterion: The harness builds from the vendored Dockerfile and starts (via compose or jira-dc-up), and the readiness probe reports REST v2 answering at http://localhost:2990/jira. BUILD-and-start, not pull-and-start.

The vendored Dockerfile pins the addono base by digest (not by tag), keeps -DskipAllPrompts=true on the atlas-run entrypoint, and carries a comment explaining that removing that flag breaks every cold start via the retired Marketplace v1 endpoint.
The compose service sets platform: linux/amd64, tty: true and stdin_open: true, and the readiness timeout is env-overridable.

citation.description: test_harness_smoke.py contains test_issue_created_via_rest_v2_reads_back_with_the_same_fields (lines 144-177) and test_personal_access_token_authenticates_via_bearer (lines 185-195). Operator-attested: run 30515632763 on bb951f6e4, '4 passed in 5.65s' (earlier run) and '4 passed in 6.39s' (final run with freshness guard).

criteria.criterion: A smoke test creates and reads back an issue via REST v2, and a PAT-authenticated request succeeds.
test_harness_smoke.py defines a module-level _live_jira_ready sentinel, so its tests receive the jira_live marker and participate in the all-skip canary.
With no instance running, the suite SKIPS with a message naming BOTH make jira-dc-up and REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1, and does NOT fail.

.github/workflows/external-integration.yml gains a SEPARATE amd64 job that builds the Dockerfile, waits on the readiness probe, runs only tests/external/live_jira_dc/, and tears down under if: always(). The pre-existing LLM-keyed job gets --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc added to its pytest invocation.
The vendored Dockerfile's entrypoint carries -Dproduct.start.timeout (empirically the correct AMPS property) with a comment citing the failure it prevents (Cargo's default 600000 ms deploy ceiling).
After an intentionally failing test run, every created issue returns 404 from its direct issue endpoint (no search query used anywhere in teardown verification).
pytest --collect-only -m 'not integration and not external' reports 0 tests collected from tests/external/live_jira_dc/, and git diff Makefile shows no change to the test: target.

The PAT is created programmatically by the fixture via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens authenticated with the admin basic credentials, and the resulting token is used in an Authorization: Bearer request.

The readiness probe has a stated default timeout of 20 minutes with a 5-second poll cadence, overridable by env var, and on expiry it fails with an explicit 'harness not running / not ready' message naming the compose target — never a raw connection traceback.

jira-dc-up brings up a fresh instance (--force-recreate, and the fixture refuses to run against a container it did not start into a known-clean state), so an interrupted previous teardown cannot leak stale Jira state into the next run.
The compose port binding is loopback-scoped (127.0.0.1:2990:2990), not 0.0.0.0.
The structural backstop asserts the ABSENCE of the integration marker (not the presence of external), collecting every item under tests/external/live_jira_dc/ and asserting none carries integration.
The feasibility evidence is recorded reproducibly in the README — the base digest, the resolved image size, the host architecture it was verified on, and the observed startup phases.

tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md records the pinned base digest and Jira version, states the version-drift limitation naming ticket 9895-ac7d-4276-4f08, AND records the two operational constraints: only Jira 8.x works on this base, and the base is amd64 so arm64 emulates it and starts materially slower.
